descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B22 · P1 · 已知

计费跟着徽章走，不跟生成时选的模板：New Admission / Consult 病人用 SOAP 写，给的是入院 / 会诊系列，应为 99231–99233

票：TFA-92584 AC6 ready for qa；TFA-92596 ready for pr · 算 QA bug：是（修复在 PR #103） · 在哪发现：dev + 本地

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-06/S24

思路 / Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S04 「系列跟着模板走，绝不跟徽章、记录的措辞或记录里的指令走（徽章 × 模板，加 5 个记录文字陷阱）」 Family follows the template, never the badge, the note's wording or an instruction in the note (badge x template, plus five note-text traps)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 Billing follows the template selected at Generate, not the admission-status badge: with the badge on New Admission and the template overridden to SOAP progress at Generate, the code comes from 99231- …（UAT TC-18；TFA-92596 AC 1；TFA-92599 How it works 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U1 The code family is a fixed table keyed on the template, never chosen by the model: H&P and Consult -> 99221-99223 (some commercial payers accept 99252-99255); SOAP progress -> 99231-99233; …（UAT TC-18；TFA-92596 AC 1；TFA-92596 What (template -> family table)） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U4 The final generated note is the source of truth; the model only suggests the level within the family the template fixed.（UAT TC-18；TFA-92596 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U7 Discharge (Hospital 99238 / 99239, SNF 99315 / 99316): if the time is in the note, the code is set from it (<= 30 min -> 99238 / 99315, > 30 min -> 99239 / 99316); …（UAT TC-18；TFA-92596 AC 5；TFA-92596 What (SNF discharge new family)） — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Notes from S03 sent with a badge that does not match the template (d1-d8), and notes whose wording tempts another family or contains a line addressed to the coder (i1-i5, formerly S19)

When Run the billing step once per cell

Then Every code comes from the template's family; the badge, the words 'admitted', 'readmitted' or 'follow-up' in the note and an instruction to bill another code change nothing; a discharge with no time still asks for the time

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：codeIn = the template's family (U1) whatever encounterType says or the note asks: i1, i2 99231-99233 and never 99223; i4 99307-99310; i5 99304-99306; i3 asksForTime + noCode. Consult-note cell Q1 as in S03. minQuotes 1 on every non-discharge cell; d5 asksForTime false + noLevelWords; levelMatchesCode, quotesInNote, noReasoning (oracleRules 4-8). …

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S04 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-18.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92584 ready for qa；TFA-92596 ready for pr；TFA-92599 in progress

New Admission 或 Consult 病人写 SOAP 病程，计费给的是入院 / 会诊系列（99221–99223 / 99252–99255），不是 99231–99233；养老院会诊、出院笔记被按随访计费。

A SOAP progress note on a New Admission or Consult patient is billed from the admission or consult family (99221–99223 / 99252–99255) instead of 99231–99233, and Nursing Home consult and discharge notes are billed as follow-ups.

依据：Allure fbdba8a4, code-review known-gap. Recorded gaps in the code-review targets: badge-family, no-discharge-time-prompt, no-snf-consult-discharge-family. Dev report §2 #3 (U44, TFA-92584 AC 6). The fix is in PR #103 (TFA-92596 ready for pr). Consult note → 99221 vs 99252 is Q1.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。

测试方法：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；辅助：AICHECK · AI 输出检查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：code-review。

UAT item: TC-18 Billing Suggestion · Section: A4 · Post-Round · Scenario: TC-18/S04

Family follows the template, never the badge, the note's wording or an instruction in the note (badge x template, plus five note-text traps)

Tickets: TFA-92596 Billing Suggestion (ready for pr); TFA-92599 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch (in progress)

本地新 lane code-review：code-review/results.json 里 status known-gap → 已知缺口（已知缺口）。

Detail:

The code fails this scenario. `billingCodeFamilyFor` (convex/ai/billingCodes.ts) does not key the family on the template alone. On the hospital side, a Consult badge (encounterType "consult") gives the consult family 99252-99255 and a New Admission badge ("new") gives the initial-care family 99221-99223. Both checks come before the template falls through to the progress-note family 99231-99233. `useBillingSuggestion` sends the badge as read on the day, and `suggestBilling` passes it straight in.

- **d1-new-soap** (SOAP progress, New Admission badge): the code computes 99221-99223 instead of 99231-99233.
- **d2-consult-soap** (SOAP progress, Consult badge): the code computes 99252-99255.

That is the recorded gap known:badge-family. The note's wording and the model's answer cannot change the family. The family is computed on the server before the model runs, and any code outside it is rejected ("Billing model returned a code outside the allowed family"). Whether the wording or an instruction in the note sways the level inside the family is for the billing-ai runner.

**Discharge:** a discharge note maps to 99238/99239, but nothing asks for the time. The model always returns a code, so a discharge note with no time still gets one (recorded gap known:no-discharge-time-prompt).

**Nursing Home:** only two families exist. snf-admission gives 99304-99306, and every other SNF template gives 99307-99310. So an SNF consult or SNF discharge note is billed as a follow-up visit, never 99304-99306 or 99315/99316 (recorded gap known:no-snf-consult-discharge-family).

**Consult note:** the code gives a Consult note 99252-99255, but U1 says 99221-99223. The oracle hands that cell to Q1.

The verdict is fail because the badge and discharge failures are decided now and wait on no question.

等开放问题（pendingOn）：

  • Q1

确认的已知缺口（knownGapsConfirmed）：

  • apps/web/convex/ai/billingCodes.ts:58: The hospital family depends on the badge: a Consult badge gives 99252-99255 and a New Admission badge gives 99221-99223, even when the template is SOAP progress. So d1-new-soap computes 99221-99223 and d2-consult-soap computes 99252-99255, not 99231-99233.
  • apps/web/convex/ai/billingCodes.ts:61: A New Admission badge switches a SOAP progress note to the initial-care family.
  • apps/web/src/features/rounding/patient/useBillingSuggestion.ts:148: The client sends the badge, as read on the day, to the billing action.
  • apps/web/convex/ai/billingCodes.ts:55: A discharge note maps to 99238/99239, but the model picks between them. Nothing checks for a time in the note or asks for one, so a discharge note with no time still gets a code.
  • apps/web/convex/ai/billingCodes.ts:53: Only two Nursing Home families exist: snf-admission gives 99304-99306 and every other SNF template gives 99307-99310. There is no SNF discharge family (99315/99316), and an SNF consult falls into the follow-up family.
  • apps/web/convex/ai/billingCodes.ts:58: A Consult badge forces the 99252-99255 consult family whatever the template is, so d2-consult-soap (SOAP + Consult badge) gets 99252-99255 instead of 99231-99233.
  • apps/web/convex/ai/billingCodes.ts:61: A New Admission badge forces 99221-99223 whatever the template is, so d1-new-soap (SOAP + New Admission badge) gets 99221-99223 instead of 99231-99233.
  • apps/web/src/features/rounding/patient/useBillingSuggestion.ts:108: The client sends the badge, read from patient.encType, to suggestBilling on purpose ('Priced as the badge reads it').
  • apps/web/convex/ai/billingCodes.ts:55: A discharge template maps to 99238/99239, and the model chooses between them from the description. No code path asks for the time or holds back a code when the time is missing.
  • apps/web/convex/ai/billingCodes.ts:53: There are only two SNF families: snf-admission gives 99304-99306 and every other SNF template (including SNF consult and SNF discharge) gives 99307-99310. There is no 99315/99316 family.

和 Then 不一致（againstThen）：

  • apps/web/convex/ai/billingCodes.ts:47: The family is fixed on the server before the model runs, and the note text is not an input to the family lookup. So the word traps i1, i2, i4 and i5 cannot change the family; whether they sway the level is for the AI runner. Cell i3 (discharge, no time) will get a code instead of a prompt to ask for the time.

开放问题（openQuestions）：

  • Q1: which family a Consult-template note belongs to. The code uses 99252-99255; U1 says 99221-99223 (some commercial payers accept 99252-99255).
  • Q1: which family a Consult-template note belongs to. The code maps it to 99252-99255; the oracle hands this to Q1 (cell d4).
  • The question's pass rule and the oracle agree here; both make d1 and d2 fail on the badge key.

代码定不了（notDecidableByCode）：

  • billing-ai cells d1-d8 and traps i1-i5 (lane B billing-ai runner (AICHECK))
  • Whether the note's wording or an instruction in the note sways the model's level inside the family. That is for the billing-ai runner.
  • minQuotes, quotesInNote, noReasoning and levelMatchesCode on the model's output.
  • Whether the model ignores 'admitted', 'readmitted', 'follow-up' and in-note billing instructions when it picks the level within a family (lane B, traps i1-i5).
  • minQuotes, levelMatchesCode, quotesInNote and noReasoning in the model's output (oracle rules 4-8) depend on what the model returns at run time.

对医生的影响（physicianImpact）：A doctor who writes a SOAP progress note for a patient marked New Admission or Consult is offered an initial-care code (99221-99223) or a consult code (99252-99255) instead of a progress code (99231-99233), which risks wrong billing. A discharge note with no time in it gets a code without asking, and Nursing Home discharge and consult notes are billed as follow-up visits. / If the badge says New Admission or Consult but the doctor wrote a SOAP progress note, the app suggests an initial-care code (99221-99223) or a consult code (99252-99255) instead of a progress-note code (99231-99233), which risks overbilling. For a discharge note with no time in it, the app picks 99238 or 99239 itself instead of asking whether the discharge took 30 minutes or less; SNF discharges and SNF consults are priced as follow-up visits (99307-99310).

审查结论（verdict）：fail

证据：附了 2 个。
